newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese jewellery retailer declared bankrupt.
newsitem.headline: Japanese jewellery retailer declared bankrupt.

text.p: A Japanese district court has declared Yokohama-based jewellery retailer Coco Yamaoka Hoshokuten and two of its group firms bankrupt with debts totalling 60 billion yen, private credit research company Teikoku Databank said on Friday.
A spokesman for Yokohama District Court confirmed it had declared the company bankrupt, but declined to confirm further details. Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Teikoku Databank said Coco Yamaoka has 112 shops nationwide.
